expected_heading: App privacy details on the App Store
paraphrase: In App Store Connect you must declare all data types that you or any third-party code in your app collect (transmit off device and retain beyond servicing the request), unless a type meets all of the optional-disclosure criteria; for each type you must state the purposes it is used for, whether it is linked to the user's identity, and whether it is used for tracking. A publicly accessible privacy policy URL is required on the product page. Answers must be kept accurate and updated whenever practices change.
